name: Numbers
lede: The fourth book of the Bible, in full: every scene, every law and every line of dialogue in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Numbering
books.blurb: In the wilderness of Sinai: take ye the sum of all the congregation; the twelve princes, the men of every tribe from twenty years old and upward that were able to go forth to war, six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty; the Levites about the tabernacle; and every man by his own standard, east, south, west and north.

books.name: The Charge of the Levites
books.blurb: The sons of Aaron, and Nadab and Abihu who died before Jehovah; the Levites given unto Aaron instead of all the first-born, Gershon westward, Kohath southward, Merari northward, the redemption of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen; and the ark, the table and the candlestick wrapped in blue, scarlet and sealskin for the sons of Kohath to bear.

books.name: Jehovah Bless Thee
books.blurb: The unclean put out without the camp; restitution with the fifth part; the law of jealousy and the water of bitterness; the vow of a Nazirite — no wine, no razor, no dead body — and the blessing put upon the children of Israel: Jehovah bless thee, and keep thee.

books.name: The Offerings of the Princes
books.blurb: Six covered wagons and twelve oxen; the twelve princes, each on his day, with a silver platter, a silver bowl and a golden spoon full of incense, for the dedication of the altar; the Voice from above the mercy-seat; the seven lamps; and the Levites cleansed and waved before Jehovah.

books.name: The Cloud and the Trumpets
books.blurb: The passover in the wilderness of Sinai, and a second passover for the men unclean by the dead; the cloud upon the tabernacle by day and the appearance of fire by night; two trumpets of silver; the camps setting forward by their standards; Hobab; and Rise up, O Jehovah.

books.name: Graves of Lust
books.blurb: The fire at Taberah; who shall give us flesh to eat?; the manna like coriander seed; Moses' burden and the seventy elders on whom the Spirit rested; Eldad and Medad; the quails and the graves of Kibroth-hattaavah; and Miriam, leprous as white as snow, shut up without the camp seven days.

books.name: The Twelve Spies
books.blurb: Twelve men sent to spy out the land of Canaan; the cluster of Eshcol borne upon a staff between two; the evil report, the children of Anak, and we were as grasshoppers; Joshua and Caleb: an exceeding good land; Moses' plea, I have pardoned; forty years in the wilderness; and the defeat at Hormah.

books.name: Korah
books.blurb: The drink-offerings and the first of the dough; the man gathering sticks upon the sabbath; a cord of blue upon the fringes; Korah, Dathan and Abiram, and the two hundred and fifty with their censers; the ground that clave asunder; Aaron standing between the dead and the living; and the rod of Aaron that budded and bare ripe almonds.

books.name: The Water for Impurity
books.blurb: The charge of the priests and the Levites; the heave-offerings, the first-fruits and the firstlings, a covenant of salt for ever; I am thy portion and thine inheritance; the tithe and the tithe of the tithe; and the red heifer without spot, burned without the camp, whose ashes in running water are a water for impurity.

books.name: Meribah and the Serpent of Brass
books.blurb: Miriam dead at Kadesh; the waters of Meribah, and the rock smitten twice; Edom refusing passage; Aaron gathered unto his people on mount Hor; the fiery serpents and the serpent of brass upon a standard; Spring up, O well; and Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites and of Bashan.

books.name: Balaam
books.blurb: Balak king of Moab sends for Balaam to curse Israel; the ass sees the angel of Jehovah in the way, and Jehovah opens her mouth; seven altars on three heights; and four parables instead of curses — How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob; there shall come forth a star out of Jacob.
